en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large stone building in a historicist style, with steep tiled roofs, arched windows and an elaborate sculptural program. A prominent corner niche holds a tall standing figure above a seated figure, and a richly decorated arched window with reliefs runs beside it. There is an arcaded loggia on the right, and tram or trolley wires run across the scene above a cobblestone street.
